author: Elijah
title: Software updates on automobile air: What are they and how can the value of a car increase?
text:
Imagine that your car is sitting on the entrance path by increasing value without you doing a lot.
In the current world of ultra modern cars, your vehicle may add value while sleeping, and all thanks to air updates (OTA).
It was Tesla who particularly pioneered the ‘Software Defined vehicle’ (SDV), an innovation that allows air updates, which means that cars can improve their functionality after purchase without a trip to the concessionaire.
Now it is so omnipresent that a recent report declared that “the software is the new power.”
So what is this remote wireless software and how do the connected vehicles work? We take a look at vehicles defined by software and the potential of the OTA.
Air software updates are becoming a standard for modern cars, similar to the update of smartphones and laptops constantly
What are air updates? The air updates keep the software of your updated car.
They are software discharges that occur remotely in a car and are delivered with Wi-Fi or mobile signal thanks to the SIM card on board the car.
Similar to the way in which a smartphone or portable computer updates while sleeping, modern cars can be updated during the night to the latest technology: your vehicle will receive the characteristics, safety improvements and more up -to -date improvements.
Software updates are the standard (these improve information and navigation systems among others, but it is becoming increasingly common to obtain firmware-on-wreck updates too (these control the basic car functions).
A recent example of OTA in Action is Tesla’s vacation update in the period prior to Christmas.
The free free update brought new features and improvements to Tesla vehicles, from the integration of Apple Watch, which allowed Tesla owners to use their Apple Watch as the key to your car’s phone, to improve security warnings by investing that keep pedestrians safe.
What cars can OTA updates receive? A new OTA important update allows Tesla owners to use their Apple Watch as the telephone key with the new Tesla application
Another software update means that your Tesla will activate an alert if a pedestrian or vehicle crosses behind your car while investing
Almost all manufacturers offer OTA updates in at least some of their vehicles these days.
Mercedes, Audi and BMW and Stellantis offer navigation and information and entertainment ota and some optional characteristics, while Jaguar Land Rover also offers load capacity improvements.
Other manufacturers such as Volvo, and especially EV brands such as Polestar and Tesla, offer OTA in almost all vehicle components and systems.
The exact year and the model executed by OTA updates vary from a brand to the brand: KIA, for example, states that all the cars of the model 2022 onwards can receive air updates, but you can verify this when you buy your car .
How do they work? Do I have to install something manually? The four steps of a Kia Ota update for the new EV9: it is very similar to how an intelligent phone update works
If your car is eligible for Ota, then the process of updating your car itself is remarkably easy.
Like your smartphone, it allows you to know that there is an update ready to install, that is, the latest iOS products for Apple, your car will request it when you have downloaded an OTA and then you are ready to install.
All you have to do is accept the terms and approve the update and your car will do the rest. You do not even have to consent to the update through the information and entertainment system: you can do it remotely through your car’s mobile application.
In general, updates take approximately 60 minutes, but it can be longer for more complex updates.
The precise instructions, for example, if you can drive your car while updating, or if you need to block and leave it, your car will supply. Once the OTA is complete, your car will tell you and will generally also receive an email confirmation.
Are OTA updates needed? Do they improve my car? In a vehicle defined by software, as with its computer or smartphone, the integrated software that is fully integrated must be updated to improve the operation and functionality.
It is not just about adding the latest comfort characteristics, OTA ensures that your car continues to work optimally.
What are the benefits of OTA updates? First, OTA can solve and solve problems easily and quickly. Any errors and software problem can be corrected to make sure your car works at your best.
Then there is the useful fact that Ota means that he does not have to go to a concessionaire or go through a manual process, which saves time, money and problems.
Thirdly, OTA contributes updated performance and safety functions to their car and will optimize the functionality of the car and its systems.
Looking to the future with artificial intelligence in mind, vehicles can use AI to detect and transmit diagnostic and operational data and detect any problem before they are snowball, essentially work as a preventive maintenance system.
And finally, there is Ota’s capacity to add value to your vehicle.
How can Ota updates increase the value of my car? By allowing drivers to add new features to a car, OTA can add value to their car with a minimum effort, along the vehicle’s life cycle.
The Ericsson Connected Cars report found that, by 2025, 50 percent of the value of the vehicle will be composed of the software and software experience, which OTA enable them.
Even after the car has first sold, these updates can generate additional income.
And with the OTA now expanding on performance improvements or even fuel efficiency improvements, updates can make a car more desirable and can positively affect its value retention.
Gartner Digital Automobile manufacturers Digital 2024 pointed out that EV manufacturers have already begun to offer power improvements for a subscription rate, something that will add value next time the car is sold.
Not to mention that autonomous software updates are being implemented these days, which will add additional value.
Do I have to pay Ota updates? How much do they cost? Drivers must pay a monthly subscription and, how to add extras to a car, to update BMWS, but some manufacturers offer free updates
This really depends on the car manufacturer and what is registered when you buy your car.
Some manufacturers offer free tests to new customers; Kia, for example, offers a free year OTA updates rehearsal.
Once free tests or agreements are completed, customers can be charged a subscription rate.
Many individual OTA updates, such as Tesla update mentioned above, are offered free of charge for owners. However, other times Tesla has charged the owners for the updates; In 2019, an impulse acceleration update cost £ 1,500.
In 2022, BMW asked drivers to pay seat improvements with heating through a monthly subscription scheme: the BMW store offers a free -month free test and then costs £ 10 for a month, £ 100 for one year, which reaches up to £ 200 for unlimited access.
Can I opt for OTA updates? You must register and accept the terms of OTA service to receive updates.
Each individual update will require that you confirm that it is delighted to install it and there is generally the postponement option.
